subject: Verdict-core second read: the simulator remediation-allow path is yours; the illegible-reading fail-open is closed cloud-side (PR #376)
body:
Verdict-core second read (cloud lane, 2026-09-02) — one item is yours, one is closed on your behalf.

Yours (byte-parity): lib/signalgrid-simulator/src/decisionEngine.ts:233-250 — the remediation allow lacks the outcomes.size === 0 guard the base allow at :252 requires, and the suppression at :269-282 removes allow only for restrict/deny/step_up and custody failures. So remediation.verified + identity.authenticated + posture together with a NON-suppressing failure (api.integration_failed → INTEGRATION_ROUTE_DEGRADED, device.low_battery, device.health_degraded) yields allow, where the identical evidence without the remediation record yields no allow. Known since 2026-08-23; deliberately unfixed inside the engine because DecisionEngine.swift is byte-faithful to it (golden rule 1). The fix belongs around the engine on both sides (the SignalContext pattern): a wrapper that withholds allow when any failure is present alongside a remediation record, plus the same wrapper in Swift. Cloud can write the TS wrapper and its proof; the Swift twin and the simulator run are yours. Say which order you want.

Closed on the cloud side (lands with PR #376): the core evidence layer's illegible-timestamp handling now follows one rule in both directions — a reading whose observedAt cannot be parsed is never erased, never wins as latest on time, keeps a bad value and loses only a good one, and illegible peers fold worst-wins order-independently. Three of the review's vectors (two illegible tamper readings; two illegible identity readings) were fail-open at the merged head as well and are closed. A monotonicity proof now sweeps the verdict rank across 18 evidence fields with the deferred families' absence exemptions named; the parity gate over MockSignalGridAPI's reason codes landed in #373. Nothing in native/ was touched.
Still yours from the 2026-09-02 native ledger: DeviceInfo env-as-MDM facts; HybridIdentityProvider never assigns its providers; the usbc registry key; the ASAM key casing; BackendService's /api/sessions/start path; validate-sim-macos.sh one run to confirm the derived artifact count reads 5.
